translated_title: Sheinbaum Defends Morena's Polls and Promises to Publish the Results
original_title: Sheinbaum defiende encuestas de Morena y promete publicar resultados
author: José Shaddai Olvera Torres
meta_description: Amid discontent over Morena's new state coordinators, Sheinbaum says she stayed out of the polling and that the results must be released to the public.
